name: Life Protocol sells pay 90% of a price that only buys move
summary: LifeProtocolContract.buy() charged the current price and then raised it, while sell() paid 90% of the current price from the contract's USDT without lowering it, so the attacker bought 1,000 LIFE fifty times with flash-loaned USDT and sold it back fifty times at the inflated price, 100 days after deployment.
